feed.title: Free small-business calculators — tools on marisstella.dev
feed.subtitle: The 254 free, browser-only tools served directly from marisstella.dev — the newest 40 of them listed here, newest first. No account, no upload: every number stays on your own device. The full catalogue is larger and lives at tools.marisstella.dev.
feed.rights: Tools are MIT-licensed. They are estimates and records to act on, not professional advice.

entry.title: GitHub Actions Minutes Estimator — What Will This Workflow Cost?
entry.summary: Paste your GitHub Actions workflow YAML and see projected monthly billable minutes and dollar cost before the allowance runs out. Names the expensive patterns: the macOS 10x multiplier, per-job rounding on wide matrices, missing timeout-minutes, PR commits built twice, over-frequent cron. Free, runs entirely in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: App Store Screenshot Checker — Catch a Rejected Icon or Wrong-Size Screenshot Before Upload
entry.summary: Free tool: drop your App Store Connect or Google Play listing images in and check them before you upload — app icon transparency (the classic "can't contain an alpha channel" rejection), wrong pixel dimensions, a HEIC renamed to .png, and a screenshot set whose members disagree about their own size. Runs entirely in your browser; nothing is uploaded. A zero-dependency CLI does the same in CI.

entry.title: CODEOWNERS Shadow Checker — Find Rules GitHub Silently Overrides
entry.summary: Free tool: paste your CODEOWNERS file and your repo's file list to see exactly which earlier, more specific rules a later, broader rule silently overrides -- GitHub's own last-match-wins resolution, the most common way a CODEOWNERS file quietly stops reviewing what you think it reviews. Nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Drone Mapping Job Calculator
entry.summary: Plan and price an aerial mapping sortie: ground sample distance from your sensor and altitude, flight line spacing, image count, airtime, battery swaps, processing hours and the price that clears your margin. Free, private, nothing leaves your browser.

entry.title: hreflang Reciprocity Check — Are Your Alternate-Language Links Actually Reciprocal?
entry.summary: Free tool: paste a page's HTML (or try fetching its alternates) and check its hreflang tags for missing reciprocal links, invalid language/region codes (en-uk vs en-GB), a missing x-default, a missing self-reference, and conflicting hreflang values. Runs in your browser or as a zero-dependency Node CLI. Nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Kubernetes Rollout Safety Check — Will Your Deployment Drop Requests?
entry.summary: Paste a Kubernetes Deployment YAML and find every reason a rolling update can drop live requests: no readinessProbe, no preStop hook, a grace period shorter than the drain, maxUnavailable covering every replica, a PodDisruptionBudget that blocks a node drain. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: llms.txt Generator — Build a Spec-Compliant llms.txt File Free
entry.summary: Paste your site's page list, a sitemap.xml, or a Markdown docs tree and get a valid llms.txt file — the emerging llmstxt.org convention that gives AI assistants a structured map of your site. Free, runs entirely in your browser, nothing is uploaded. Validate an existing llms.txt too.

entry.title: Redirect Chain Checker — Find Redirect Loops, Long Chains & Dead Ends
entry.summary: Free tool: paste the hops a URL's redirects actually took (from your browser's Network tab, or a curl -sI trace) and check for a redirect loop, a chain longer than the recommended single hop, an HTTPS-to-HTTP downgrade, a permanent site move using a temporary status code, and a chain that dead-ends in a 404 or 500. A zero-dependency CLI follows the real chain over HTTP for you. Runs in your browser or as a CI check. Nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Sitemap lastmod Freshness Check — Is Your Sitemap Faking Freshness?
entry.summary: Free tool: paste a sitemap.xml and check its <lastmod> dates for the freshness-faking anti-pattern Google's own sitemap documentation warns about -- invalid/malformed W3C-Datetime format, a future-dated lastmod, duplicate URLs with conflicting dates, and a suspiciously uniform date across nearly every URL. The Node CLI also cross-checks each URL's live HTTP Last-Modified header. Runs in your browser or as a zero-dependency CLI. Nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Screen Printing & Embroidery Price Calculator — Cost Per Shirt, Setup & Margin
entry.summary: Free screen printing, embroidery and DTF pricing calculator for custom apparel shops: work out your real cost per shirt from screens or digitising, press or stitch time, blanks and spoilage, then see the break-even price, the margin at what you quoted, and what the same job costs at 12, 24, 48, 72, 144 and 288 pieces. Runs entirely in your browser.

entry.title: Bounce House Rental Calculator
entry.summary: Price a bounce house or inflatable rental booking from the truck's two round trips, setup and teardown labor, a generator when there is no outlet, a wet-unit attendant, and insurance sized to your fleet's replacement value — not just a flat per-unit-per-day rate. Free, private, nothing leaves your browser.

entry.title: Cache-Control Checker — Vary: *, public + Set-Cookie, weak ETags
entry.summary: Free tool: run a CLI that sends one real request to your site, then paste the JSON here for a plain-English report on Vary: * (uncacheable forever), Cache-Control: public alongside a Set-Cookie header (a shared cache can leak one visitor's cookie to another), and lower-severity caching directive conflicts. Nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Canonical Tag Checker — Conflicting, Cross-Domain & Dead-End Canonicals
entry.summary: Free tool: fetch a URL for real and get a plain-English report on canonical-tag misconfigurations -- conflicting tags, a canonical pointing at a different domain, or a canonical that 404s or is itself marked noindex. Nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Cookie Security Checker — SameSite=None, __Host-/__Secure- prefixes
entry.summary: Free tool: run a CLI that sends one real request to your site, then paste the JSON here for a plain-English report on SameSite=None cookies missing Secure (which current browsers reject outright), broken __Host-/__Secure- prefix cookies, and missing Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite. Nothing uploaded.

entry.title: CORS Misconfiguration Checker — Reflected Origin, Null Origin, Unanchored Allow-Lists
entry.summary: Free tool: run a CLI that sends real requests with crafted Origin headers to your API, then paste the JSON here for a plain-English report on reflected-origin, null-origin, and unanchored allow-list CORS misconfigurations. Nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Craft Fair Booth Calculator — Is This Market Worth Taking?
entry.summary: Free calculator for makers: find what one craft fair, farmers market, or art festival booth has to sell to break even after booth fee, jury fee, mileage, materials, and card fees — plus your real hourly rate for the weekend and the most a booth could cost and still be worth it. Unsold stock is treated as inventory, not a loss.

entry.title: Docker Base Image Pin Check — Are Your FROM Lines Pinned to a Digest?
entry.summary: Paste your Dockerfile and find every FROM line referencing a base image by a mutable tag like node:18 instead of a pinned content digest (@sha256:...). Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Email Authentication Checker — Free SPF, DKIM, DMARC & BIMI Checker
entry.summary: Free SPF, DKIM, DMARC and BIMI checker: paste any domain and get a plain-English report on why your email might be going to spam, with the exact DNS record read and what it means. Nothing uploaded -- your browser queries public DNS directly.

entry.title: IFTA Quarterly Fuel Tax Calculator
entry.summary: Work your IFTA quarterly return from your own trip and fuel records: average fleet MPG, taxable gallons and net taxable gallons per jurisdiction, the Indiana/Kentucky/Virginia surcharge charged the way it is actually charged, and interest on a late return. Free, private, nothing leaves your browser.

entry.title: Merchant Feed Check — Catch Google/Meta Shopping Feed Errors Before They Disapprove Products
entry.summary: Paste or load a Google Merchant Center / Meta Catalog product feed (CSV, TSV, or JSON) and get a deterministic, item-by-item report of missing required fields, invalid GTIN checksums, malformed prices, and the documented disapproval triggers -- before the crawler finds them. Free, runs entirely in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: GitHub Actions OIDC Trust Policy Checker — AWS sub/aud conditions
entry.summary: Free tool: paste an AWS IAM role trust policy and see whether its GitHub Actions OIDC conditions actually restrict which repository, branch or environment can assume the role. Catches a missing sub condition, a wildcard that spans repositories, repo:org/name:* (which includes pull requests from forks), and a literal * under StringEquals. Nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: PWA Installability Checker — Manifest, Icons, Display Mode
entry.summary: Free tool: run a CLI that fetches your page, its Web App Manifest, and every icon it lists, then paste the JSON here for a plain-English report against Chrome's installability criteria -- the same checks Lighthouse's installable-manifest audit runs, no Chrome required. Nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Security Headers Checker — Clickjacking, CSP unsafe-inline, HSTS
entry.summary: Free tool: run a CLI that sends one real request to your site, then paste the JSON here for a plain-English report on missing clickjacking protection, X-Frame-Options: ALLOW-FROM being ignored by current browsers, a CSP that allows unsafe-inline or wildcard script sources, and missing HSTS. Nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Self-Storage Rate Increase Calculator
entry.summary: Price an existing-customer rate increase (ECRI) at your storage facility: what one induced move-out really costs once the unit re-rents at street rate, and the move-out rate at which the increase stops paying. Free, private, nothing leaves your browser.

entry.title: Social Preview Checker — Open Graph, Twitter Card, LinkedIn link previews
entry.summary: Free tool: run a CLI that sends real requests to your page and its og:image/twitter:image, then paste the JSON here for a plain-English report on missing tags, a relative og:image URL, an image too small for Facebook/LinkedIn or Twitter's large-image card, and the twitter:image -> og:image fallback chain. Also check any image URL's real pixel dimensions right in this page. Nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Subresource Integrity (SRI) Checker & Hash Generator
entry.summary: Free tool: generate a sha384 integrity= hash for any script or stylesheet, or run a CLI that checks a page's cross-origin tags for a missing integrity attribute, a missing crossorigin attribute, or a hash that no longer matches what the CDN serves. Nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Staffing Markup Calculator
entry.summary: Price a staffing placement properly: employer burden per hour, the real gross margin behind your markup, the break-even markup, and the markup a target margin needs. Free, private, nothing leaves your browser.

entry.title: Wash and Fold Price Per Pound Calculator — Cost, Break-Even & Margin
entry.summary: Free wash and fold pricing calculator for laundromats and laundry pickup-and-delivery routes: work out your real cost per pound from labour minutes, wash and dry cycles, supplies, delivery stops and overhead, then see the break-even price per pound and the margin at what you charge today. Runs entirely in your browser.

entry.title: Wildlife Exclusion Bid Calculator
entry.summary: Price a bat, raccoon, squirrel or bird exclusion job from the visits it really takes — daily trap checks, the height the seal is at, attic decontamination, and a reserve against the warranty you sold — instead of the flat removal fee your customer is shopping. Free, private, nothing leaves your browser.

entry.title: GitHub Actions Artifact Poisoning Check — workflow_run Download & Execute
entry.summary: Paste your GitHub Actions workflow YAML and find a workflow_run job that downloads an artifact and later executes something from it, plus a download-artifact step with no name: pin. Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Affiliate Disclosure Checker — Is Your Amazon/FTC Disclosure Missing or Too Late?
entry.summary: Paste a blog post's HTML and see every affiliate link it recognises (Amazon Associates tag= links, amzn.to, rel=sponsored, ShareASale/CJ/Impact/Skimlinks/AWIN tracking links) and whether a disclosure appears before the first one — plus whether an Amazon link carries Amazon's own required exact statement. Free, runs entirely in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Chrome Extension Permission Checker — Unused & Missing Permissions
entry.summary: Free, browser-local checker: scans your extension's JavaScript/TypeScript source for chrome.* API usage and compares it against manifest.json's declared permissions, so an unused or missing permission doesn't cost you a Chrome Web Store rejection ('Purple Potassium'). Nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: .env.example Drift Check — Does Your Example File Match the Code?
entry.summary: Paste your .env.example and your source code and see every environment variable the code reads (process.env, os.getenv, os.environ, ENV[], System.getenv) that the example file never mentions -- the #1 cause of a fresh clone crashing right after install. Free, runs entirely in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: package.json Exports Drift Check — Does "exports" Point at Files That Exist?
entry.summary: Paste your package.json and a listing of the files you actually publish and see every literal target in the "exports" map that points at a file that doesn't exist -- the cause of ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED and Cannot find module right after npm install. Free, runs entirely in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Structured Data Drift Check — Does Your JSON-LD Match the Page?
entry.summary: Paste a page's HTML and see whether its JSON-LD (FAQPage, HowTo, Article, Product, LocalBusiness/Organization, Review) actually says, word for word, what the page's own visible text says. Google requires FAQPage and HowTo content to be visible. Free, runs entirely in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: WordPress Plugin Review Checker — Stable Tag, Escaping & Nonce Issues
entry.summary: Free, browser-local checker for WordPress plugin developers: catches a readme.txt Stable tag that doesn't match your plugin's Version header, missing required readme/header fields, unescaped $_GET/$_POST output, and $_POST handling with no nonce check -- before wordpress.org Plugin Review does. Nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Certified Payroll Calculator — Davis-Bacon Overtime & Fringe Compliance
entry.summary: Free calculator for Davis-Bacon / prevailing-wage certified payroll: checks whether a worker's cash wages plus fringe meet the wage determination, and computes overtime correctly when part of the fringe is paid in cash instead of a bona fide plan.

entry.title: iOS Privacy Manifest Checker — Required Reason API vs PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy
entry.summary: Free, browser-local checker: scans your Swift/Objective-C source for Apple's Required Reason API usage and compares it against your PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy manifest, so a missing declaration doesn't cost you an App Store rejection (ITMS-91061 / ITMS-91055). Nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Newsletter Sponsorship Rate Calculator — Free, No Sign-Up
entry.summary: Free newsletter sponsorship rate calculator. Enter your list size, open rate, and niche to get a price range for a dedicated send, primary placement, secondary placement, and classified ad — based on commonly cited newsletter-ad-market CPM benchmarks. No sign-up, nothing uploaded.

entry.title: Security Deposit Refund & Prorated Rent Calculator — Free, No Sign-Up
entry.summary: Free security deposit refund calculator: itemize deductions against a tenant's deposit and see the refund or balance due. Plus a prorated rent calculator for a partial first or last month. Entirely client-side, nothing uploaded.
